steps.instruction: Toast 2 teaspoons of Szechuan peppercorns in a dry pan for 3 minutes.
steps.spoken: Toast 2 teaspoons of Szechuan peppercorns in a dry frying pan for about 3 minutes.

steps.instruction: Grind the peppercorns with 8 star anise pods in a grinder.
Sift the ground spices to remove any larger bits.
Mix in 1/2 teaspoon of ground cloves and 1 tablespoon of ground cinnamon.
Mix in 1 tablespoon of ground fennel seeds.
Grind the mixture again until it is a very fine powder.
Use it sparingly, as it is very strong.
